```{r loading data}
library(sf)

arboretum <- st_read("inventaire-botanique.geojson")
```

```{r}
nrow(arboretum)
st_geometry_type(arboretum)
st_crs(arboretum)
```

```{r}
#library(dplyr)

# Check missing values in each field
missing_summary <- arboretum |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(
    across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x) | .x == "")
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "field",
    values_to = "missing"
  ) |>
  filter(missing > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(missing))

missing_summary
```

```{r création 2ème base de données finale pour le site}
arboretum_web <- arboretum |>
  filter(statut == "Existant") |> #Note: Abattus et NA exclus d'office
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      type == "G" ~ "Liane",
      type == "P" ~ "Palmier",
      TRUE ~ type
    )
  )
```

```{r mise en forme données pour champ de recherche Espèce}
# Create a taxonomic matching key for each plant
arboretum_web <- arboretum_web |>
  select(-any_of(c("nom_taxonomique", "libelle_espece", "taxon_key"))) |>
  mutate(
    espece = if_else(
      !is.na(genre) & (is.na(espece) | trimws(espece) == ""),
      "sp.",
      as.character(espece)
    ),
    taxon_key = paste(
      coalesce(as.character(genre), ""),
      coalesce(as.character(espece), ""),
      coalesce(as.character(sous_espece), "")
    ),
    taxon_key = na_if(trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", taxon_key)), "")
  )


# Count the different common names for each taxon
noms_communs <- arboretum_web |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(
    !is.na(taxon_key),
    !is.na(nom_vernaculaire),
    trimws(nom_vernaculaire) != ""
  ) |>
  count(taxon_key, nom_vernaculaire, name = "effectif")


# Select the most frequent common name for each taxon
nom_prefere <- noms_communs |>
  arrange(taxon_key, desc(effectif), nom_vernaculaire) |>
  group_by(taxon_key) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(taxon_key, nom_vernaculaire)


# Count the number of distinct common names per taxon
stats_noms <- noms_communs |>
  count(taxon_key, name = "nb_noms_communs")


# Create one menu entry for every taxon, even without a common name
especes_menu <- arboretum_web |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  distinct(taxon_key) |>
  filter(!is.na(taxon_key)) |>
  left_join(stats_noms, by = "taxon_key") |>
  left_join(nom_prefere, by = "taxon_key") |>
  mutate(
  nb_noms_communs = coalesce(nb_noms_communs, 0L),

  libelle_espece = case_when(
    # Genus-only entries never receive an asterisk
    grepl(" sp.$", taxon_key) ~ {
      if_else(
        nb_noms_communs > 0,
        paste0(taxon_key, " (", nom_vernaculaire, ")"),
        taxon_key
      )
    },

    # Multiple common names
    nb_noms_communs > 1 ~
      paste0(taxon_key, " (", nom_vernaculaire, ") *"),

    # One common name
    nb_noms_communs == 1 ~
      paste0(taxon_key, " (", nom_vernaculaire, ")"),

    # No common name
    TRUE ~ taxon_key
  )
)
```



```{r exports pour site}
# Convert list columns into text
collapse_values <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(value) {
    value <- as.character(unlist(value, use.names = FALSE))
    value <- value[!is.na(value)]
    value <- value[nzchar(trimws(value))]

    if (length(value) == 0) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      paste(value, collapse = ", ")
    }
  }, character(1))
}


# Prepare plant data for the website
arboretum_export <- arboretum_web |>
  mutate(
    plant_id = sprintf("plant-%04d", row_number()),
    across(c(continent, orig_geo), collapse_values)
  ) |>
  select(
    plant_id,
    id_arbre,
    taxon_key,
    genre,
    espece,
    nom_latin,
    nom_vernaculaire,
    famille,
    collection,
    plantation,
    continent,
    orig_geo,
    type
  )

sf::st_write(
  arboretum_export,
  "website/data/plants.geojson",
  driver = "GeoJSON",
  delete_dsn = TRUE,
  quiet = TRUE
)


# Count the number of individual plants per taxon
effectifs_especes <- arboretum_web |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(taxon_key)) |>
  count(taxon_key, name = "effectif")


# Prepare the menu data
especes_menu_export <- especes_menu |>
  left_join(effectifs_especes, by = "taxon_key") |>
  select(taxon_key, libelle_espece, effectif) |>
  arrange(desc(effectif), libelle_espece)

especes_menu_export |>
  filter(grepl(" sp\\.$", taxon_key)) |>
  arrange(taxon_key)

# Export
jsonlite::write_json(
  especes_menu_export,
  "website/data/especes-menu.json",
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  pretty = TRUE
)

origines_menu_export <- arboretum_web |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(plant_row = row_number()) |>
  select(plant_row, continent) |>
  tidyr::unnest_longer(continent) |>
  mutate(continent = trimws(as.character(continent))) |>
  filter(!is.na(continent), continent != "") |>
  distinct(plant_row, continent) |>
  count(continent, name = "effectif") |>
  arrange(desc(effectif), continent)

jsonlite::write_json(
  origines_menu_export,
  "website/data/origines-menu.json",
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  pretty = TRUE
)
```

```{r export liste famille taxonomique}
familles_menu_export <- arboretum_web |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(famille), trimws(famille) != "") |>
  count(famille, name = "effectif") |>
  arrange(desc(effectif), famille)

jsonlite::write_json(
  familles_menu_export,
  "website/data/familles-menu.json",
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  pretty = TRUE
)
```



```{r checks}
fichiers <- file.path(
  "website/data",
  c("plants.geojson", "especes-menu.json")
)

tibble::tibble(
  fichier = basename(fichiers),
  existe = file.exists(fichiers),
  taille_Ko = round(
    file.info(fichiers)$size / 1024,
    1
  )
)

# Verify plant fields
plants_check <- sf::st_read(
  "website/data/plants.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)

names(plants_check)

# Verify species counts
menu_check <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  "website/data/especes-menu.json"
)

menu_check |>
  filter(grepl("^Tilia cordata$", taxon_key))
```

```{r}
# Check genus-only entries
especes_menu |>
  filter(grepl(" sp.$", taxon_key)) |>
  arrange(taxon_key)


# Check that no genus-only entry has an asterisk
especes_menu |>
  filter(grepl(" sp.$", taxon_key)) |>
  filter(grepl("\\*", libelle_espece))


# Count plants associated with genus-only entries
arboretum_web |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(grepl(" sp.$", taxon_key)) |>
  count(taxon_key, sort = TRUE)
```
